about: Goodwin Law works from Tamiami Trail North and names five people. It publishes more about the transaction than any other firm in this ranking: six stages of a closing, from the title search and the survey through the estoppel and the settlement statement to recording the deed.

It is also one of five firms here that state a flat fee, and the only one that makes a promise about it: that the engagements are priced as flat fees and the fee quoted does not change. No figure, which nobody in this market publishes. Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 67 reviews. PageSpeed could not complete a measurement of the site, so pillar D carries no Core Web Vitals reading rather than a zero.
